CustomField.description: This field will be checked if a review that was previously approved is being reviewed for an increase and the review type needs to be updated. The field will be checked allowing for the funding record to be updated once upon the increase review process beginning. It will be unchecked once the review type has been changed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This box will be checked only by the vf_balancesheet apex class upon an approved review being opened for an increase review.
CustomField.label: Allow Review Type Update
